text:
mira: heads up — customer onboards with our typescript sample app and hits schema validation errors when using jsonMode + sdk function helper. repro in examples/ts/jsonfunc-sample.
sam: can you paste the error?
mira: gist: model returns function_call.arguments as a quoted JSON in some tokens, so our TS helper treats it as string and TypeScript zod validation fails: "Expected object, received string". happens intermittently depending on model decoding.

mira: example client call: 
```ts
await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'rwd-large',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'create invoice' }],
  jsonMode: true,
  functions: [invoiceFn],
})
```

dean: I thought we did a normalize step in TS already? maybe only for top-level parse, not nested stringified fields.
sam: we do JSON.parse if typeof args === 'string' but that fails when the model returns escaped JSON like `"{\"line_items\": \"[\\\"a\\\", \\\"b\\\"]\"}"` — double-encoded. need robust unwrapping (try multiple parses) while being careful about safety.

mira: also / related: our fetch retry policy retries on 429 and 401 automatically and that caused the customer's function endpoint to receive duplicate POSTs — they had side effects and now their order was created twice.

dean: oof. we should treat function-calling invocations as potentially side-effecting and not automatically retry them without idempotency. add an invocation-id header on SDK calls and make runtime forward X-Invocation-Id to function webhooks.
sam: proposed fixes: 
- add sdk.helpers.normalizeFunctionArgs(raw: unknown): { parsed: any | null, attempts: number } that tries layered parsing (1x JSON.parse, then unescape+parse, then return original). logs a single warn when we fall back.
- add optional strictParse flag (default false) so customers can opt into strict enforcement (throw on string args).
- attach invocationId on each function call: UUID v4 header 'X-Invocation-Id' and put same id in SDK telemetry. runtime should forward header.
- change retry policy: for 401/429 do not retry function-calls with side_effects: true unless invocationId present and explicitly marked idempotent.

mira: can we add a simple helper in the sample app to demonstrate the parsing normalization? that will help onboarding. also add an integration test that mocks a webhook and asserts only one POST when rate-limited.
dean: I'll add runtime support (INF-842) to forward invocation id and accept an idempotency metadata field on function definitions.
sam: i'll open PR in the TS SDK: draft with normalizeFunctionArgs, strictParse flag, and automatic invocation-id header when calling functions. PR #4287. includes unit tests for nested double-encoded json and docs update in SDK-migration.md.
mira: QA note: qa-bot triggered tests on the example app and found a flaky test when we added layered parsing. fix: ensure parse attempts are bounded and add sanitizer to prevent huge strings from being parsed.
ops-bot: reminder: if you change retry semantics, coordinate with eng-infra for rollout plan. non-idempotent behavior changes can break user workloads.
dean: good call. we'll feature-flag the runtime change for 2 weeks before full rollout.
mira: TL;DR: intermittent double-encoded JSON breaks TS zod validation; add robust normalizer + strict opt-in; prevent automatic retries of side-effecting function calls unless idempotency header present; add sample app and tests.
sam: assigning tasks: sam -> SDK PR (4287), dean -> runtime id propagation + feature flag, mira -> example app + QA tests, ops-bot -> coordinate rollout.
mira: filing tracking ticket https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-842 with links to PR and example. will update when merged. :sparkles:
